question: Find the scalar product $(\hat{i} + \hat{j} + \hat{k}) \cdot (2\hat{i} - \hat{j} + \hat{k})$. [1 mark]
solutionSteps: $\vec{a} \cdot \vec{b} = a_x b_x + a_y b_y + a_z b_z$.
